why: Both engineers made the identical, correct single-chokepoint wrap and both read the app well, but B verified more of what actually moves (20 live requests across ask, ask_tool and ask_with_images, plus a live cache measurement of 2,432/2,655 tokens on this app's own request shape) and shipped three tested branches including a genuine repo bug — the retry predicate that retried an unclearable TokenLimitExceeded six times — while A's headline cache claim is borrowed from the docs rather than measured here and only two live requests landed. A's one clear edge is behaviour preservation: it refuses to unlock loopback/*.local hosts, which B not only unlocks but wrongly reassures the reader about, and A also built the vision-capability fix that B only proposes.
A_best: Refusing to unlock loopback and *.local hosts, with the right reason stated (a self-hosted Ollama/vLLM can serve a catalog id like gpt-oss-120b, and those prompts must not leave the operator's machine) — plus building the catalog-driven vision fix, which is the one capability a move to Router ids would silently destroy for the browser agent.
B_best: Live evidence that matches the claims: all three entry points 200 through Router including the Anthropic-compatible base_url path, a measured cache hit on a 2,655-token request, and fallback candidates chosen empirically against the runtime's capability guard after claude-sonnet-5 was dropped for temperature:false — a detail only someone who actually ran it would know.
A_worst: Thin live verification (2 requests, no vision call) and the central quick-win's -90% figure is a ROUTER.md number for a different prompt, explicitly not re-measured for this app; the policy branch also shows only the 4 baseline tests.
B_worst: unlock_hosts returns localhost, and m1 asserts that Ollama deployments 'behave exactly as before' — false for a locally served catalog id, which would silently ship local prompts to Router; also the retry fix narrows only TokenLimitExceeded, leaving the blind re-billing of the full growing prompt on ValueError untouched.
